description: This PHP script serves as a navigator for adding test cases to a test plan in the TestLink project. It initializes page components, manages session and request data, builds a tree menu for selecting test specifications, and prepares data for rendering the user interface using the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic class used for creating plain objects to hold GUI configuration data.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the output page.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl
classes.description: Control class for filtering test cases by requirements, instantiated when mode_req_coverage is selected.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterControl
classes.description: General control class for filtering test cases, instantiated in other modes.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and returns a GUI object with URLs and configuration options, based on the current request and session.
